title: Hear the jet pass overhead
summary: The jet engine moves with the aircraft. A short release sound gives way to falling air and the ground impact.
rationale: Both passes use the same aircraft and quay cameras, at native effects volume with music muted. Only the game audio changes.

sources.caption: Previous audio followed by updated audio
